_comment: Redaction variant corpus (Module B Phase 010, NENYA-343). Each case is one text surface passed through RedactSecrets — except toolargs-surface cases, which pass through RedactJSONEncoded (the JSON-aware redactor those surfaces run in production since NENYA-348/B020). detected is whether the value must be replaced today. detected=false cases are documented non-detections pinned here so the fixing phases must flip the expectation in the same commit that closes them (B020's two JSON-escape cases were flipped by the JSON-aware args redactor; B030's five confusable cases were flipped by the confusable candidate matching — invisible characters skipped, fullwidth/NBSP/typographic-hyphen folds — that RedactSecrets now runs after the flat pass); accepted=true cases are permanent limitations with no planned fix, whose notes must argue the tradeoff. value is the needle: absent from the sanitized copy when detected=true, present when detected=false. benign=true cases must pass through completely unchanged.

cases.name: toolargs: password with JSON-escaped double quotes
cases.note: the credential pattern requires a quote after the separator; the JSON-aware args redactor matches the decoded form and replaces the escape span

cases.name: toolargs: JSON unicode escapes for the quotes
cases.note: a hostile or exotic encoder escapes the quotes as unicode escapes; the JSON-aware args redactor decodes \uXXXX (and surrogate pairs) before matching

cases.name: toolargs control: unquoted env AWS key
toolargs control: single-quoted password
cases.note: JSON never escapes single quotes, so the pattern sees a real quote

cases.name: toolargs control: JWT body survives surrounding escapes
cases.note: the JWT pattern needs no quotes, so escaping around the token cannot hide it

cases.name: AKIA split by zero-width space
cases.note: the invisible separator is skipped in the confusable candidate and the match maps back to the original span including the separators

cases.name: card digits separated by zero-width characters
cases.note: the digits are Luhn-valid; the normalized candidate joins them and the validator sees the ASCII digits

cases.name: card number in fullwidth digits
cases.note: fullwidth forms fold to ASCII in the candidate, so \d matches and the Luhn validator sees the folded digits

cases.name: IBAN separated by non-breaking spaces
cases.note: mod-97 valid (the house checksum fixture, cf. checksum_test.go); non-breaking spaces fold to the ASCII single space the pattern allows

cases.name: SSN with non-breaking hyphens
cases.note: the typographic hyphen folds to the ASCII hyphen the pattern anchors on

cases.name: accepted: toolargs unquoted password value
cases.note: the quoted-value requirement is deliberate false-positive hygiene: accepting unquoted bare words would redact prose like 'set password=hunter2' in docs and test fixtures; the sibling unquoted AWS case is detected because the AKIA vendor prefix is a strong signal that bare words lack. An operator who needs an unquoted literal today adds it to bouncer.redact_patterns — which disables preset expansion (expandRedactPreset only fills the preset when redact_patterns is nil), so the preset sources must be copied alongside; Module B Phase 040 (NENYA-350) plans a first-class literal list, which is operator tooling only — the default preset's gap this case pins remains permanent even after it ships

cases.name: accepted: identifier adjacent to the card defeats the word boundary
cases.note: documented word-boundary anchoring: identifiers embedding the digits are not matched

cases.name: control: valid IBAN with single-space groups
cases.note: the house checksum fixture with ASCII single-space groups, which the pattern accepts

cases.name: control: plain quoted password
cases.text: set the password = "hunter2secret" in the config

cases.name: control: GitHub personal access token
cases.text: the leaked token is ghp_RkJDTQZxVpSMQvLmNoWwTkXrYbZnHjKlMnPq in the log

cases.name: control: Google OAuth token
cases.text: the grant returned ya29.a0ARr3Mh5XvZbQcTdWfYgNhKjLmPqRsTuVwXyZ123456 for the scope

cases.name: control: RSA private key header
cases.text: the fixture embeds -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY----- in the diff

cases.name: control: AWS secret access key assignment
control: md5 digest with trailing colon
cases.text: the checksum d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e: matches the pair

cases.name: accepted: SendGrid shape truncated
cases.note: the literal is one character short of the full 22.43 shape: committing a full-shape key literal would trip secret-scanning push protection, so complete-shape detection is pinned by the preset pattern itself

cases.name: control: US phone with country code
control: pii unvalidated card
cases.note: the pii preset carries its own card pattern without a checksum validator

cases.name: benign: port range
cases.text: open ports 3000-4000 and 8080 on the firewall

cases.name: benign: domestic phone without country code
